a.text: According to Shogun Midnight's underlings, the snowy mountain has begun to change, no doubt due to the Iju's influence.
The Iju is Houei's fated enemy, and needs to be dealt with as quickly as possible lest the curse spread, with horrific consequences.
Iju Hunters, I beseech thee join me, and complete this hunt!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Iju Hunter Catapult, ready to depart!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Got everything you need?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's see... tent, rations, fincatching gear, telescope, pickaxe, capture net, BBQ grill—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: All accounted for!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This isn't a camping trip!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Where did you get all those things anyway?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Kindhearted cityfolk have been handing these out like candy over the past couple of days. We are heroes, after all. Everyone loves a hero.

spans.text: Kindhearted cityfolk have been handing these out like candy over the past couple of days. We
heroes, after all. Everyone loves a hero.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And this is all proper hunting equipment, I'll have you know!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How is any of that supposed to help us hunt the Iju?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It is never the wrong choice to learn the lay of the land before a hunt.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How's the mountain looking?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: According to our scouts, they sense heat waves as they approach the mountain.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The Iju's handiwork, no doubt.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But you need not be so eager to rush in. This strange phenomenon has yet to spread beyond the mountain.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's still better to settle this quickly.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hofukaru can barely hold herself back either!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...I am in perfect control of myself.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Your axe and the look on your face would like to politely disagree.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: There's one thing I'm curious about, though. Do we really need this many people for this?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I thought it was just gonna be me, Orchid, and Hofukaru.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: This isn't your average hunt, so the more the meowwier!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: With me as your guide, this will be over in the twitch of a whisker!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: We've got this guy with us too!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, that's one cool tuskbeast!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Menacing growl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, okay, easy there, buddy!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is he the other—

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Indeed! He's the other previous Iju Hunter, Yoshitsune! He's just worried about mew!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: We'll be right on your tail.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What of you, Shogun? Dost thou not intend to accompany us?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Do not worry, I have the utmost faith in Your Majesty.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Our scouts discovered traces of many cursed beasts slaughtering each other within the bamboo forest.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Something so unusual requires my personal attention.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I am only here to see Your Majesty off before I leave myself.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Rest easy. So long as the target of your hunt does not change, I will not interfere.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I am of a mind to make thee our new quarry...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That would also be acceptable.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And with that, I wish Your Majesty happy hunting.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Are you coming with us too, Suponosuke?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I'm not feeling it.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: If I didn't have to give you guys your equipment, I wouldn't have even left the house.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Could you try it on already? I didn't get any sleep last night, finishing it up.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I just wanna head back and fall into bed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ooooooh, new gear, new gear!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, it fits me perfectly, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Of course it does. I tweaked the designs myself. If it didn't, that would mean Suponosuke made a mistake somewhere.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nah, he's got the skills. He wouldn't screw up something that simple.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I suppose he does.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: How does your purr-sonalized equipment feel?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hmm... Like my whole body's a little lighter? But I feel a bit stronger too.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're right. It's subtle, but I really do feel stronger. How is that possible?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Because of special forging techniques!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: In short, it'll help mew on your hunt!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So you don't know either.

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Growl of agreement)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Of course I don't know! I'm a Meowcenary, not an apprentice smith! Not knowing is normal!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ooh, is this my new weapon?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purr-cisely! It's different from the one you picked up before. This one's a true blue hunting weapon!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heheh... now I really feel like chopping something.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How about you be my sparring partner, Yoshitsune?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Disapproving growl)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Orchid, would mew like to try shooting this apple off my head?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, you say you're not interested in hunting, but you're still into it in the end.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If I'm going to use a bow, I'm going to use it properly.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm not like you. Don't burn yourself out like usual, and start crying for another weapon.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I won't!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The charge blade is my fated companion! I can feel it!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It better be.
After a quick test session, the two head off with Hofukaru.
Catapult is bursting with excitement. Her interest in her new weapon stems from the hope, deep in her heart, that she can challenge ever greater enemies.
By contrast, Orchid is filled with worry, as usual. She knows that what lies ahead of them is no easy battle.
But at least she got to give her input on her new outfit, and it suits her tastes. That much makes her a little happy.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Right, one more thing!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: We could get into a fight at any meowment.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: And mew can't fight without eating a hunter's meal first!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You brought food?!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purrcisely!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I'll treat mew to a Kamura Village specialty—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oooh, I hope it's got lots of meat!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Bunny Dango!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eh? Shouldn't a hunter's meal be like, meat and booze?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sweets, huh? I'll pass.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: This is purr-ejudice!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You'll learn the error of your ways once mew try some!
